issue.title: Fix "Maximum update depth exceeded" in the source audio player [Viewing and listening to resources Audit]
issue.body:
Found during the viewing and listening to resources audit (#531, epic #526).

**Severity:** Medium  
**Launch blocker:** No  
**Confirmed on:** Xiaomi Redmi Note 9 Pro, Android 10 (API 29), local run of `main` @ `fb634e5`, `dev.api.fluent.bible` (scenarios G.x, dev LogBox; exact trigger not isolated)

## Summary
The dev LogBox showed `Maximum update depth exceeded` while only the source audio player was used on the Bible tab (no draft takes played). #569 covers the same error on Record tab take playback through `useVerseAudio`; the source player runs a separate path (`src/hooks/useSourceAudio.ts`, `src/components/layout/SourceAudioShell.tsx`).

## Expected
Using the source audio player never triggers an update-depth error.

## Actual
G.x: `Maximum update depth exceeded` in the dev LogBox; exact trigger not isolated (play, pause, verse taps and scrub were used).

## Steps to reproduce
1. Dev build, Bible tab: play, pause, tap verses and scrub the source audio.
2. Watch the LogBox or Metro logs.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Trigger and component stack identified.
- [ ] Fix does not regress #412 / #408 source playback.
- [ ] Regression test where reproducible in Jest.
- [ ] Physical Android QA across several sessions with no update-depth error.

## Related
- #569 (same error, draft takes), #412, #408
- Parent audit: #531 (epic #526)
- Related gap: #595 (source audio player)
- Assessment: `docs/assessments/viewing-and-listening-to-resources/README.md` (PR #590)
